mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS batch_estate_market_reports ( report_id VARCHAR(40) PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, lawd_cd VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, deal_ymd VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, collected_at VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, item_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, avg_deal_amount INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, max_deal_amount INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, min_deal_amount INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ai_summary TEXT, ai_status VARCHAR(30), pdf_path VARCHAR(1000), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
ALTER TABLE batch_estate_market_reports MODIFY deal_ymd VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS batch_estate_market_items ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, report_id VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, source_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, lawd_cd VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, deal_ymd VARCHAR(6) NOT NULL, apt_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, dong VARCHAR(100), jibun VARCHAR(100), deal_amount INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, area DECIMAL(10, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, floor INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, build_year INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, deal_date VARCHAR(10), raw_address VARCHAR(500), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INDEX idx_batch_estate_report_id (report_id), INDEX idx_batch_estate_lawd_deal (lawd_cd, deal_ymd) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch_estate_market_reports (report_id, title, lawd_cd, deal_ymd, collected_at, item_count, avg_deal_amount, max_deal_amount, min_deal_amount, ai_status) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{title}, #{lawdCd}, #{dealYmd}, #{collectedAt}, #{itemCount}, #{avgDealAmount}, #{maxDealAmount}, #{minDealAmount}, #{aiStatus})

INSERT INTO batch_estate_market_items (report_id, source_type, lawd_cd, deal_ymd, apt_name, dong, jibun, deal_amount, area, floor, build_year, deal_date, raw_address) VALUES
(#{item.reportId}, #{item.sourceType}, #{item.lawdCd}, #{item.dealYmd}, #{item.aptName}, #{item.dong}, #{item.jibun}, #{item.dealAmount}, #{item.area}, #{item.floor}, #{item.buildYear}, #{item.dealDate}, #{item.rawAddress})

INSERT INTO houseinfos (apt_seq, sgg_cd, umd_cd, umd_nm, jibun, road_nm_sgg_cd, road_nm, road_nm_bonbun, road_nm_bubun, apt_nm, build_year, latitude, longitude) VALUES
( CONCAT('BT', #{item.lawdCd}, '-', SUBSTRING(MD5(CONCAT_WS('|', #{item.lawdCd}, #{item.dong}, #{item.jibun}, #{item.aptName})), 1, 10)), #{item.lawdCd}, COALESCE(( SELECT SUBSTRING(dc.dong_code, 6, 5) FROM dongcodes dc WHERE dc.dong_code LIKE CONCAT(#{item.lawdCd}, '%') AND dc.dong_name = #{item.dong} LIMIT 1 ), '00000'), #{item.dong}, #{item.jibun}, #{item.lawdCd}, '', '', '', #{item.aptName}, #{item.buildYear}, NULL, NULL )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE apt_nm = VALUES(apt_nm), build_year = VALUES(build_year), umd_nm = VALUES(umd_nm), jibun = VALUES(jibun), umd_cd = VALUES(umd_cd)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING(dong_code, 1, 5) AS lawd_cd FROM dongcodes WHERE dong_code IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(dong_code) >= 5 ORDER BY lawd_cd
